bullets.text: Sowmiya Anbumani raised concerns over alleged thousands of crores in irregularities at the Pallikaranai Marshland threatening Chennai, and the office should monitor environmental oversight.
Three suspects were arrested within six hours after history-sheeter V. Maithreyan was hacked to death in Adyar, and the office should track police safety measures.
Economist A. Kalaiyarasan was allegedly humiliated by police over a fake social media post, and the office should watch handling of digital complaints.
Illegal construction debris dumped to encroach government land near the Velachery-Taramani railway road is being cleared, and the office should oversee site restoration.
Garbage and rainwater accumulation in Thiruvanmiyur MRTS station exit stairs is causing foul stench, and the office should coordinate cleanliness actions with railways.
The Water Resources Department stepped up estuary dredging from Pudhupattinam to Pazhaverkadu to improve monsoon flood discharge, and the office should monitor flood preparations.
Five factory workers in Gummidipoondi suffered vomiting and dizziness after eating canteen food containing a dead lizard, and the office should check food safety compliance.
A 62-year-old woman named Mallika contracted dengue fever in Avadi and was hospitalized, and the office should ensure vector control measures are enforced.
Minister announced that Tamil Nadu set aside Rs 50 crore for startups to foster AI, animation, and gaming technologies, and the office should track funding rollout.
L&T's Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW data centre in Chennai to support high-density AI workloads, and the office should support infrastructure expansion.
Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation issued a tender for an AI-enabled control center to handle power complaints, and the office should oversee tech integration.
Opposition leaders condemned the Tamil Nadu government over the daylight murder in Chennai, and the office should monitor law and order criticism.
Academic A. Kalaiyarasan wrote to the police chief alleging harassment by Tambaram cops, and the office should watch police accountability regarding the case.
